evidence: The injected TTIP solution was thermally evaporated in a vaporizer kept at 200°C and carried to the horizontal reactor by Ar carrier gas of 200 sccm. H2O gas was used as a reactant and was supplied from a reservoir kept at 10°C by its own vapor pressure for 1 s. Following the precursor injection and the gas supply of H2O, the reactor was purged with 500 sccm Ar gas for 3 and 20 s, respectively, unless otherwise specified.
